test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘WATER’ is written as ‘18120523’ and ‘BURNT’ is written as ‘202118142’. How will ‘STRAIN’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The pattern followed here is.

__**The first and the last letter positional value is interchanged.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ec42491e9890ada79d3fd748dea681d18b8aeeed1119c19180cf84a22a28681.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef097a2c58a410680fcb68d4560a1bc212ea040e4012c2633c43d5dce51d69a4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is __**1420181919**__**.**
